Stronger second verdict: node experiments/e_x0_pocs.mjs -> EX0 VERDICT 8/8 PASS, chain 4 links verify=true + file re-verify=true, tip 7c2a6341828c3506 (byte-identical to committed ex0_summary.json). essence: field is primary: non-collapsing hex-lattice scratch-paper, soft JEV writes, recorded observation, content-addressed proof

ideas.name: Field is primary (the inversion)
ideas.statement: The primary object is a parallel relational field — cells on a hex lattice carrying soft amplitudes (gamma crystallisation, eta possibility, Delta creativity) — while every sequential presentation (the old CoT tape) is only a dependent projection (right Kan extension) of it; nothing sequential is ever forced.

ideas.name: Soft writes, never tokens
ideas.statement: The JEV emits only soft vectorized progressions: the seed's Cell.softWrite is a convex order-dependent blend, and the crowned 'ledger' naturality policy (Cell.accumulate) makes writes a COMMUTATIVE multiset union with amplitudes aggregated purely at sense time — the wave stays open by construction.

ideas.name: Observation is a recorded local act
ideas.statement: observe() is the ONLY collapse: it zeroes the target cell's prob_mass and pins a definite Delta override — neighbours and distant loci stay fully open (PoC 3: target 0, neighbour 1, distant 1); attending and projecting deform nothing.

ideas.name: The field is the proof object
ideas.statement: Every event — attend, deform, refuse, observe, program_attach — is content-addressed (sha256 over canonical JSON, chained prev-hash from EXOJ-GENESIS); verifyChain replays in memory AND from the saved file, so the field itself is the objective proof object; refusals are counted and chained, never silent.

ideas.name: Quilt projection, programs, donnable shell
ideas.statement: The agent touches the field through a quilt projection (touched-cell snapshots), read-only 'show your work' projections per observer, temporal programs that fire on schedule independently of the linear algebra, and a donnable exoj-shell-v1 save/load that round-trips the raw cell state plus the whole chain.

parts.name: hex geometry
parts.essence: axial hexDist = (|dq|+|dq+dr|+|dr|)/2 and hexRing neighbourhood enumeration — the metric all locality (rings, distance-weighted priors) hangs on.
parts.failure_mode: a wrong axial distance would corrupt every locality-dependent statistic

parts.name: content-addressing primitives
parts.essence: canonicalJSON (sorted keys, no undefined), sha256Hex, and chainHash(row, prev) = sha256(canonicalJSON([prev, row-without-hash])) — the exact chain basis the fleet shares.
parts.gate: key order can never change a hash (sorted canonical form)
parts.failure_mode: non-canonical serialization would let reordered keys forge different proof objects

parts.name: cell state bundle
parts.essence: Cell carries gamma/eta/delta (seed view), delta_override (observe-pinned definite), strength, frags (content-addressed identity fragments), programs, touched, prob_mass, plus the ledger-policy accumulators G/E/D/aSum/n.
outputs: cell with default eta=1, delta=0.5, prob_mass=1 (fully open)
parts.gate: a never-touched cell is fully open: prob_mass = 1.0, gamma = 0
parts.failure_mode: a closed-by-default cell would fake prior knowledge

parts.name: soft_write (seed reference)
parts.essence: convex blend (1-alpha)*old + alpha*new for each amplitude, alpha=0.4; strength = max(strength, gamma); prob_mass relaxes upward 0.98*p + 0.02; order-DEPENDENT by design — the verbatim seed semantics kept as one honest arm.
parts.gate: alpha fixed at 0.4 default; write is convex (no overshoot of the targets)
parts.failure_mode: order-dependence is why e_x1 crowned the ledger policy — retained as the reference arm, not deleted

parts.name: accumulate (ledger naturality policy)
parts.essence: commutative alpha-weighted accumulation into G/E/D/aSum — a multiset union of write targets; any permutation of the same write multiset lands bit-near-identically (float residual ~1e-15, receipted in e_x1).
parts.gate: permutation of the same writes changes nothing beyond ~1e-15 float noise
parts.failure_mode: parallel observers writing in different orders would disagree — the exact naturality failure E-X1 killed

parts.name: amps() aggregate read
parts.essence: the ONLY place the ledger policy aggregates: gamma=G/aSum, eta=E/aSum, delta = delta_override ?? D/aSum — a definite Delta from observe() outranks any accumulated aggregate.
parts.gate: delta_override outranks the aggregate once set
parts.failure_mode: aggregating over a pinned observation would un-collapse a collapsed cell

parts.name: normalizeView (pure sense-time projection)
parts.essence: if the active-cell mean Sigma exceeds 1, rescale gamma/eta in the VIEW only — the 'deferred' fix: normalisation never mutates cell state or the ledger.
parts.gate: state untouched after normalisation (pure read)
parts.failure_mode: the seed's in-place renorm silently mutates bystander cells — measured as collateral_mutations/collateral_mass telemetry

parts.name: field construction (the surface)
parts.essence: ExoJ(name, radius=4, policy) builds the 61-cell lattice Map, seq counter, deformations/observations lists, observers, the event chain with tip EXOJ-GENESIS, and the stats block (norms_fired, shaved_mass, collateral_*, refusals).
parts.gate: lattice contains exactly the cells with hexDist <= radius

parts.name: receipt chain (_push / verifyChain)
parts.essence: every event row gets row_hash = chainHash(row, tip) and advances the tip; verifyChain replays from EXOJ-GENESIS and names the failing seq and why ('missing row_hash' / 'hash mismatch'); tip survives save/load.
outputs: chained rows + tip + {ok, links, tip} verdict
parts.gate: verifyChain ok in memory AND from the reloaded file (PoC 8: links=14, both ok)
parts.failure_mode: any byte edited anywhere in history breaks the chain at that row

parts.name: attend (observer registration)
parts.essence: registers an observer at the current seq and pushes a chained 'attend' row — registering to watch is itself a recorded act, but deforms nothing.
parts.gate: attending leaves Sigma/prob_open identical to 1e-15 (PoC 4)
parts.failure_mode: observation-on-attend would make watching itself collapse the wave

parts.name: seed _norm (honest negative kept)
parts.essence: the seed's silent field-wide renorm after EVERY emit: if active mean Sigma > 1.001, rescale EVERY active cell — kept verbatim but instrumented: norms_fired, shaved_mass, collateral_mutations and collateral_mass (bystander cells moved by a write aimed elsewhere) are counted into stats.
parts.gate: collateral mutations are COUNTED, never hidden (e_x2 crowned the alternatives on this telemetry)
parts.failure_mode: a silent global renorm couples every write to every cell — the anti-naturality case

parts.name: off-lattice fold to origin
parts.essence: jevEmit/observe/attachProgram fold an off-lattice (q,r) to the origin (0,0) — seed-compatible grace instead of a crash.
parts.failure_mode: a silent fold could mask a caller bug — accepted seed-compat tradeoff, visible in the chained row's q/r

parts.name: refuse policy (conservation boundary)
parts.essence: quilt-dba mirror policy: a write whose post-Sigma on the TARGET CELL would exceed 1.0 (+1e-12 float guard) is REFUSED — ledger unchanged, refusal COUNTED and chained with would_be_Sigma recorded.
parts.gate: post gamma+eta <= 1.0 + 1e-12 or the write never lands; refusals are never silent
parts.failure_mode: the boundary is exact in the reference (1585 ok / 1586 refuse); float translation needs the receipted 1e-12 guard

parts.name: jev_emit (soft vectorized progression)
parts.essence: the JEV step: write (gamma,eta,delta) softly via the active policy, stamp a content-addressed 8-hex identity fragment (name|q|r|seq|backend), attach the program if any, seq+=1, push the chained 'deform' row with cell_Sigma_pre recorded.
inputs: (q, r, gamma, eta, delta, opts{tag, program, backend, alpha})
parts.gate: in-band emits conserve gamma+eta=1 exactly (PoC 5: 100/100, max deviation 0.0)
parts.failure_mode: a hard token emit here would collapse the field — the charter's core prohibition

parts.name: observe (the only collapse)
parts.essence: zeroes the target cell's prob_mass, pins delta and delta_override to the definite value, seq+=1, pushes the chained 'observe' row with prev_prob recorded — the ONLY act that collapses, and it is recorded.
parts.gate: PoC 3 sealed rule: target prob_mass == 0 AND hex-neighbour >= 0.999 AND distant cell >= 0.999 (local, never global collapse)
parts.failure_mode: any global collapse path would break the chain-of-probabilities claim

parts.name: attachProgram (schedule receipt)
parts.essence: attaches an 'every' (period/next cursor) or 'at' (one-shot) program to a cell and pushes a chained program_attach row snapshotting the spec — the receipt freezes the schedule at attach time because the live cursor advances on every fire.
parts.gate: the chained spec is a deep copy frozen at attach time
parts.failure_mode: chaining the live cursor would make history mutate as programs fire

parts.name: tick (temporal programs fire)
parts.essence: advances every touched cell's programs to time t: 'every' fires (and refires by period) as soft jevEmit refreshes tagged program:<id> at alpha=0.2; 'at' fires once and marks done; returns the fired list.
outputs: fired list + chained program-tagged deform rows
parts.gate: PoC 7: every-program fires exactly at t in {3,6,9} and at-program exactly once at t=5 by t=10
parts.failure_mode: programs are amplitude-independent — they tick cell-groups without touching the linear algebra

parts.name: sense() (pure field readout)
parts.essence: pure read: active-cell means of gamma/eta/delta, Sigma, Sigma_normed, max_cell_Sigma, zone fraction (Delta in [0.4,0.6]), prob_open, deformation/observation counts, observers, policy, chain_tip, norms_fired, refusals.
parts.gate: PoC 1 sealed rule: |Sigma - 1.0| <= 1e-9 AND max_cell_Sigma <= 1 + 1e-9 after balanced writes
parts.failure_mode: a sense that mutated state would make every read a write

parts.name: project (show-your-work slice)
parts.essence: read-only dependent projection per observer: format exoj-projection-v1, sense, last 12 deformations, last 5 observations, chain_tip, and the non-collapse note — the auditor's first-person log.
parts.gate: PoC 6: appends ZERO chain rows and leaves Sigma/prob_open unchanged to 1e-15
parts.failure_mode: a projecting observer that wrote would turn audit into intervention

parts.name: quilt snapshot
parts.essence: quiltSnapshot() = toDict() of every touched cell — the spatial projection the agent actually sees: rounded amplitudes, strength, prob, last 4 frags, last 3 programs, touched count.
parts.gate: untouched cells never appear (the sheet shows only what the wave has visited)

parts.name: save (donnable shell v1)
parts.essence: persists format exoj-shell-v1: sense, quilt snapshot, cells_raw (both seed view and ledger accumulators plus delta_override), deformations, observations, observers, stats, the FULL chain and its tip.
parts.gate: cells_raw carries G/E/D/aSum/n so the ledger policy round-trips exactly
parts.failure_mode: dropping raw accumulators would lose naturality across a save/load

parts.name: load + post-load verification
parts.essence: ExoJ.load rehydrates the shell (defaulting missing delta_override to null) and the PoC battery re-verifies the chain FROM THE FILE — the reloaded field must prove itself.
parts.gate: PoC 8: verifyChain ok from the SAVED file after load; tip identical to in-memory
parts.failure_mode: a load that skipped chain verification would boot forged history

parts.name: conservation policy registry
parts.essence: policy selects the write law: 'seed' (silent renorm + collateral telemetry), 'deferred' (pure sense-time normalisation), 'ledger' (commutative accumulation, crowned by E-X1), 'refuse' (hard per-cell boundary) — four pricing arms over one field.
parts.gate: unrecognised policy simply takes the seed branch (documented default), all four enumerated in the header law
parts.failure_mode: mixing policies mid-stream would make comparisons meaningless

parts.name: JEV backends (soft-only contract)
parts.essence: classical / jepa / quantum-inspired / cellular-llm backends emit soft vectors into the field — the interface contract, not the field's business, which amplitudes they produce; offline deterministic makeBackend(seed).
parts.gate: PoC 5: 100/100 emissions across 4 backends have Delta in [0.4,0.6] AND |gamma+eta-1| <= 1e-9, read from the chained payloads
parts.failure_mode: a backend emitting a definite token would violate the soft-only contract

parts.name: decision rules sealed before results
parts.essence: e_x0 books run.config, then a poc_rules row with the exact PASS expression per POC, and only then computes numbers — receipts BEFORE interpretation; the receipt chain itself is sealed and re-verified from the written file.
outputs: sealed rules rows -> results rows -> verdict rows
parts.gate: rules rows precede result rows in the chain (structural, chain-ordered); no post-hoc verdicts
parts.failure_mode: rules written after numbers would make every PASS unfalsifiable

parts.name: verdicts computed from telemetry
parts.essence: each PoC verdict is a boolean expression over numbers read from the chained events and sense() — never asserted; summary + verdicts persisted to ex0_summary.json with the chain tip.
parts.gate: EX0 VERDICT line is 8/8 PASS only if every sealed rule evaluates true AND the chain verifies in memory and from file
parts.failure_mode: verdicts drafted in advance would be costume, not evidence

cells.expr: cells = {(q,r) : hexDist(q,r,0,0) <= 4}  (61 cells, open by default)
cell = {gamma:0, eta:1, delta:0.5, prob_mass:1, G,E,D,aSum, frags, programs, touched}
jevEmit(q,r,g,e,d,{backend,tag,program}) -> policy write + frag + chained deform row
policy='refuse': postG+postE > 1+1e-12 ? chained refusal (counted) : write lands
observe(q,r,definite): prob_mass=0, delta_override=definite, chained observe row — the ONLY collapse
attachProgram + tick(t): every/at refreshes as alpha=0.2 soft emits tagged program:<id>
sense(): Sigma, Sigma_normed, max_cell_Sigma, zone, prob_open, counts, chain_tip (pure)
project(observer) -> exoj-projection-v1 slice; appends ZERO rows
save(path) / ExoJ.load(path): exoj-shell-v1 with cells_raw + full chain + tip
row_hash = sha256(canonicalJSON([prev_tip, row])); verifyChain from EXOJ-GENESIS

layer_logic.0: irreducible substrate: axial hex geometry, canonical sorted-key JSON + sha256 chainHash, and the cell bundle (open by default, eta=1, prob_mass=1) with its ledger accumulators
layer_logic.1: soft transforms: softWrite (order-dependent seed arm) vs accumulate (commutative ledger arm), silent-renorm telemetry, observe as the only collapse, temporal programs ticking independent of amplitudes
layer_logic.2: policy arms priced: four conservation policies (seed/deferred/ledger/refuse), the soft-only backend contract, and the e_x0 law that decision rules are sealed in the chain BEFORE the numbers
layer_logic.3: surfaces: attend/project quilt projections (zero-row reads), quiltSnapshot sheet, exoj-shell-v1 save/load, off-lattice fold-to-origin grace
layer_logic.4: proof object: every deform/observe/attend/refuse/program_attach content-addressed and chained; verifyChain in memory AND from file; PoC verdicts computed from telemetry only (8/8 PASS of record)
